title: Deaccession Stamp
object: Wood-handled rubber stamp, 60 x 20 mm impression. Black archival ink pad included.
wall_label: Deaccessioning is the formal removal of an object from a permanent collection. Museums do it quietly, in writing, with a committee. The internet does it never. This stamp restores the missing procedure to the general public.

notes.Provenance: Manufactured 2026. Intended use: laptops, notebooks, the back of anyone's hand, printed screenshots of arguments you have already won.
